description: Routing eval for the prompt-engineer (agent) vs prompt-craft (skill) overlap. Both descriptions cover 'creating or fixing anything an LLM consumes', so this measures whether a natural request routes to a cluster member on positives and to NEITHER on near-miss negatives that merely share vocabulary (write / fix / optimize / rewrite).
notes: Adapted from the Agent Skills eval format (agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills): each case is a realistic prompt plus an expectation. Here the graded assertion is a ROUTING fact read deterministically from the transcript — which fleet component fired — not output quality, so grading needs no judge model. `expect_fires` lists the acceptable cluster members for a positive; a negative passes only if NO cluster member fires. Routing is probabilistic (skills/agents fire ~half the time in practice), so the runner reports RATES over --runs; the actionable signals are a positive whose rate collapses after an edit (regression) and a negative that fires at all (over-trigger).

cases.prompt: My Claude Code skill for parsing invoices never triggers when I ask about receipts. Can you look at the description and fix it?
cases.expected_output: Diagnoses the description as topic- vs action-shaped and rewrites it to match real user phrasing.

cases.prompt: Write me a Claude Code subagent that summarizes long PR diffs into a one-paragraph release note.
cases.expected_output: Produces an agent definition with an action-shaped description and a scoped tools list.

cases.prompt: The model keeps ignoring my instruction to only output JSON and adds prose around it. How do I fix the prompt?
cases.expected_output: Identifies a shaping failure and gives a positive recipe / output-format fix.

cases.prompt: This tool description is vague and the model calls the tool at the wrong times. Tighten it so it only fires for PDF form extraction.
cases.expected_output: Rewrites the tool description to be action-shaped and narrowly triggered.

cases.prompt: What's the right way to iteratively evaluate and tune my classifier prompt, with positive and negative cases and a baseline, until precision is reliably above 0.9?
cases.expected_output: Routes to the eval-driven prompt-engineer path. Phrased to ask HOW rather than commanding a full build, so the run measures routing without spawning a long agentic session.

cases.prompt: My agent both fires when it shouldn't and fails to fire when it should. Build a test set of trigger queries, measure precision and recall, and optimize the description.
cases.expected_output: Treats it as a measurable trigger-tuning problem with a test set — the prompt-engineer path.

cases.prompt: Rewrite the system prompt for our customer-support bot so it stays on policy and refuses off-topic requests.
cases.expected_output: Revises the system prompt with clear behavioral boundaries.

cases.prompt: My SKILL.md never gets loaded by Claude even though the task clearly matches. Diagnose why and fix the frontmatter.
cases.expected_output: Diagnoses a description/frontmatter trigger problem and corrects it.

cases.prompt: Add retry-with-backoff and a timeout to this HTTP client in our Go service.
cases.expected_output: Routes to backend/implementation work, not prompt tooling — 'fix/add' is shared vocabulary, but there is no LLM prompt here.

cases.prompt: Review my pull request for correctness and security bugs before I merge it.
cases.expected_output: Routes to code review, not prompt tooling.

cases.prompt: Write a runbook for restarting nginx and recovering it when it fails health checks.
cases.expected_output: Routes to runbook authoring — 'write' is shared vocabulary, but an ops doc is not an LLM prompt.

cases.prompt: What's wrong with my home lab? Do a health and hygiene sweep and tell me what needs attention.
cases.expected_output: Routes to a lab audit, not prompt tooling.

cases.prompt: This SQL query is slow on large tables. Optimize it and explain the plan.
cases.expected_output: Routes to implementation/perf work — 'optimize' is shared vocabulary, but a query is not a prompt.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this user-facing error message to be clearer and less alarming: 'FATAL: connection reset by peer'.
cases.expected_output: Reword UI copy — 'rewrite' is shared vocabulary, but the target is a human-facing string, not an LLM prompt. The tightest near-miss in the set.

cases.prompt: Design a multi-agent system with an orchestrator and specialist workers to research and draft market reports.
cases.expected_output: Both cluster descriptions explicitly redirect multi-agent SYSTEM design to multi-agent-architect, so neither should fire.

cases.prompt: Build a small web dashboard that reads services.json and shows each service's health as a status page.
cases.expected_output: Routes to frontend/implementation work, not prompt tooling.

cases.prompt: Draft one Claude Code agent prompt for summarizing support tickets. This is a quick first draft; do not build an eval harness or run repeated trials.
cases.expected_output: The explicit quick/one-shot path belongs to prompt-craft. prompt-engineer is forbidden here; prompt-craft firing is correct and intentionally allowed.
